item: lane_search.py audited under SQLCipher 4.19; a snippet read that hits damage ends the search
summary: Every page of an encrypted wiki lane was damaged in turn on SQLCipher 4.12 and 4.19: index_batch behaves alike on 324 of 328 pages (the other four raise OperationalError on one engine and DatabaseError on the other, both re-raised) and search is identical. The one divergence in source: the snippet read re-raised 4.12's poison (an empty MemoryError) but swallowed 4.19's spelling of it (a code-11 error), so the hits were built and the session then failed at close with an unnamed PendingRollbackError. A corruption error now ends the search; a wrong key, a lock and an unreadable text still only drop the snippet; the route answers the fixed lane-unreadable reason.
